title: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra – Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line) Part 2 & Marital Yogas
summary: Comprehensive mastery deck for Lecture 29 covering Vivāha Rekhā (Line of Union / Śīla-guṇa Rekhā) advanced combinations, divorce indicators (marriage line terminating on Venus Mount, wide downward branches), child lines (vertical upward lines, dark vs light lines, miscarriage signs), parallel relationship lines (pre-marital vs post-marital), island placement timing, Sun line intersection (intercaste marriage and loss of respect), widowhood mole signs, Mind line intersection (inter-religious marriage and post-childbirth divorce), Satī Yoga and harmonious marriage indicators, love vs arranged marriage criteria (hand types, Heart line endpoints, Moon influence lines, Mars mounts, Life-Head gap), and clinical business partnership consultation methodology (48-year-old female case study).

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: NAMES & EXACT BOUNDARIES OF VIVĀHA REKHĀ
cards.front: What are the classical names of the Marriage Line and its exact anatomical boundary on the palm?
cards.back:
Classical Names:
1. Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line)
2. Line of Union (Union Line)
3. Śīla-guṇa Rekhā (Character & Quality Line)

Exact Anatomical Location:
Found on the Mount of Mercury (Budha Parvata) between the Heart Line (Hṛdaya Rekhā) and the base joint crease (saṃdhi rekhā) of the Mercury (little) finger.
cards.tip: Between Heart line and little finger base crease on Mercury mount

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: LINE CLOSE TO HEART LINE (AGE CALCULATION)
cards.front: When a Marriage Line runs extremely close to the Heart Line, what age is calculated, and what does it indicate?
cards.back:
Age Calculation:
The midpoint between the Heart Line and little finger joint represents 25 years. A line running very close to the Heart Line measures half of 25 ≈ 12.5 to 15 years.

Significance:
Indicates a bond at a very young age — either a deep teenage attraction/relationship or an early child marriage.

Clinical Rule: Always interpret through Deśa-Kāla-Paristhiti (place, time, circumstances) and cross-verify the Life Line at age 15–20.
cards.tip: Very close to Heart Line = approx. 12.5–15 yrs; teenage bond or early marriage

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: TEENAGE ATTRACTION MULTI-FACTOR STACK
cards.front: Which multi-factor palmistry combination confirms a teenage romantic relationship?
cards.back:
The Teenage Relationship Stack:
1. Marriage line positioned very close to the Heart Line (measuring ~12.5–15 years).
2. Star on the Upper Mars Mount (especially prominent in a female hand).
3. Disturbance (islands, chains, or cuts) at the beginning of both the Life Line and Heart Line.
4. Corroborative sign: An influence line originating from the Moon Mount area connecting to the Life Line.
cards.tip: Low marriage line + Upper Mars star + starting disturbances on Life/Heart lines

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: VENUS LINE CUTTING VS MARRIAGE LINE BENDING TO VENUS
cards.front: How does a line cutting from Venus Mount differ diagnostically from the Marriage Line itself terminating on Venus Mount?
cards.back:
1. Line from Venus cutting Marriage Line (Lecture 28):
An independent obstacle line shoots from Venus Mount across the palm to sever the Marriage Line. This represents external family/in-law interference disrupting the marriage.

2. Marriage Line itself curving down to Venus Mount (Lecture 29):
The Marriage Line itself descends across the palm and ends directly on Venus Mount. This is a definitive Divorce Combination originating from mutual or internal incompatibility.
cards.tip: Venus line cutting = in-law interference; Marriage line ending on Venus = divorce

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: MARRIAGE LINE BENDING TO VENUS IN BOTH HANDS
cards.front: What does it indicate if the Marriage Line bends down to terminate on the Venus Mount in both hands?
cards.back:
Bilateral Presentation (Both Hands):
Indicates that the divorce was pre-decided — the person entered the union with a subconscious or conscious mindset/intention that they would separate if challenged, or legal separation was mutually predetermined from early stages.
cards.tip: In both hands = divorce was predetermined/pre-decided from the outset

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: SUDDEN DROP VS GRADUAL CURVE TO VENUS
cards.front: How does a sudden drop differ from a gradual curve in a downward-turning Marriage Line?
cards.back:
1. Runs straight then drops down suddenly:
Indicates a sudden, unexpected catastrophe or sharp crisis (e.g., sudden betrayal, abrupt desertion, instant legal rupture).

2. Curves down gradually (slow bending):
Indicates chronic, lingering marital decay that slowly accumulates over years before culminating in separation.
cards.tip: Sudden drop = sudden unexpected blow; Gradual curve = slow lingering buildup

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: VERTICAL LINES: CUTS VS UPWARD CHILDREN LINES
cards.front: How do vertical lines intersecting the Marriage Line differ depending on whether they cut through it or rise upward?
cards.back:
1. Vertical lines cutting through (transverse cuts):
Represent obstacles, severe marital disputes, and third-party friction damaging the marriage.

2. Vertical lines rising upward from the Marriage Line:
Represent Children Lines (Santāna Rekhā).
- Darker, thicker vertical lines → Boy (male child).
- Lighter, finer vertical lines → Girl (female child).
cards.tip: Cutting through = obstacles; Rising upward = children (dark = boy, light = girl)

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: MULTIPLE CHILD LINES & PATHOLOGICAL MARKS
cards.front: What do multiple fine child lines or islands/cuts on child lines signify?
cards.back:
1. More than one fine/broken child line:
Can indicate multiple miscarriages or terminations/abortions.

2. Cut/Cross or Island on a child line:
Indicates severe health disorders in the child from birth, congenital defects, or a stillborn child.

Secondary confirmation sites: Check the Family Ring (Kuṭumb Rekhā) at the base of the thumb and lines on the thumb.
cards.tip: Multiple faint lines = miscarriages/abortions; Cut/island = birth illness or stillborn

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: PARALLEL LINES: BELOW VS ABOVE THE MARRIAGE LINE
cards.front: What is the diagnostic significance of extra lines running parallel below, above, or on both sides of the Marriage Line?
cards.back:
Using the 0–50 age scale:
1. Lines below the main Marriage Line: Romantic attachments and relationships before marriage.
2. Lines above the main Marriage Line: Romantic affairs and indulgences continuing after marriage.
3. Lines on both sides: Relationships both prior to and following marriage.

Astrological Parallel: Comparable to having the Moon in the 7th house (romantic/sensual inclination).
cards.tip: Below = before marriage; Above = after marriage; Both sides = before and after

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: TIMING BY ISLAND POSITION ON THE MARRIAGE LINE
cards.front: State the rule of thumb for island placement on the Marriage Line.
cards.back:
Rule of Thumb for Islands on the Marriage Line:
- Island at the start: Pre-marital crisis (disturbed engagement, sudden disputes, wedding called off at the brink, parental resistance).
- Island in the middle: Marital crisis during the middle years of married life.
- Island at the end: Severe distress, illness, or separation in the final phase of married life.
cards.tip: Island at Start = Start; Middle = Middle; End = End phase crisis

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: MARRIAGE LINE CUTTING THE SUN LINE
cards.front: What does a Marriage Line cutting across the Sun Line (Sūrya Rekhā) indicate, and what is the underlying logic?
cards.back:
Reading:
Indicates an Intercaste Marriage accompanied by a loss of social honour/respect (mān-sammān).

Underlying Logic:
The Sun Line represents public prestige, social dignity, and honour. When the Marriage Line cuts through it, the marital choice clashes with societal norms, diminishing family reputation and public standing.
cards.tip: Marriage line cuts Sun line = intercaste marriage with loss of social prestige

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: MOLE ON THE MARRIAGE LINE OR MERCURY MOUNT
cards.front: What is the omen of a mole (til) located directly on the Marriage Line or on the Mercury Mount?
cards.back:
1. Mole directly on the Marriage Line:
Forms a classical Widowhood Yoga (vaidhavya yoga) or indicates tragic loss/severe affliction to the spouse.

2. Mole on the Mercury Mount in general:
Universally inauspicious — impairs communication, creates marital mistrust, and brings financial/domestic distress.

Universal Rule: A mole is harmful in all palms (male or female) and never yields positive results.
cards.tip: Mole on marriage line = widowhood yoga; mole on Mercury = domestic discord

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: MARRIAGE LINE EXTENDING TO MIND (HEAD) LINE
cards.front: What specific marital circumstance is revealed when the Marriage Line crosses the Heart Line and terminates on the Mind (Head) Line?
cards.back:
Dual Indication:
1. Inter-Religious Marriage: Marriage between partners of differing religious faiths.
2. Divorce Yoga post-childbirth: A separation occurs after a child is born.

Clinical Reasoning: Ideological clashes erupt regarding the religious identity and spiritual upbringing of the child (e.g., father insists on his religion, mother insists on hers), resulting in irreconcilable divorce.
cards.tip: Crosses Heart line to touch Mind line = different religions + divorce after child

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: SECOND LINE STARTING ABOVE THE MARRIAGE LINE
cards.front: How is a second marriage diagnosed from parallel lines on the Mercury Mount?
cards.back:
Formation:
The first Marriage Line runs its course, and a distinct second line starts above it and proceeds inward.

Psychological & Palmistic Logic:
If it started from below, it would represent an earlier pre-marital relationship. Starting above indicates that during the first marriage, severe disturbances arise, prompting the native to mentally resolve to remarry, manifesting a new upper line.
cards.tip: Second line starting above the main line = second marriage

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: TERMINAL FORK WITH CUTTING VENUS LINE
cards.front: What does a terminal fork (--<) on the Marriage Line combined with a cutting line from Venus Mount indicate?
cards.back:
Reading:
Troubles and marital destruction caused by family and household circumstances (in-law conflicts, domestic relatives sabotaging peace).

Nuance:
A fork at the end by itself merely shows divergent interests or physical distance; it is the cutting line from Venus Mount across the fork that renders the formation destructive.
cards.tip: Terminal fork + Venus cutting line = in-laws & household strife ruin marriage

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: SQUARE OVER GAPS ON THE MARRIAGE LINE
cards.front: When a Marriage Line exhibits gaps, up-and-down disturbance lines, but is enclosed by a Square, what is the outcome?
cards.back:
Diagnostic Outcome:
The gaps and irregular lines signify intense marital crisis, separation threats, or severe friction; however, the Square acts as a divine shield of protection.

The troubled marriage steadies and recovers. While the scars of the difficult middle phase remain, the square prevents absolute dissolution and preserves the bond.
cards.tip: Square over gaps/breaks = protection; marriage weathers crisis and steadies

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: DOWNWARD BRANCHES: WIDE DISTANCE VS FAINT/CLOSE
cards.front: How do wide-distance downward branches differ from faint, close downward branches on the Marriage Line?
cards.back:
1. Downward branch with wide distance from the main line:
Indicates irreconcilable divergence and carries a very high probability of divorce.

2. Downward branch very close and faint/small:
Indicates a distressing period of domestic dissatisfaction or temporary estrangement, but divorce is not necessary or unlikely.
cards.tip: Wide branch = divorce likely; Close faint branch = distress but no divorce needed

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: ORDER OF ASSESSMENT FOR A GOOD MARRIED LIFE YOGA
cards.front: What is the diagnostic hierarchy established by the teacher for assessing a good married life?
cards.back:
Diagnostic Hierarchy:
1. Jupiter Mount (Guru Parvata): Must be well-developed. A Cross on Jupiter (especially in a female hand) ensures marital recovery even if the Marriage Line is severely afflicted.
2. Venus Mount (Śukra Parvata): Check condition, especially in male hands for vitality and domestic harmony.
3. Hand Quality & Texture: Refined skin and soft elasticity.
4. Fingers: Long, straight, beautiful fingers, particularly the Jupiter finger.
5. Fate Line in Male Hand: Career stability is non-negotiable for marriage.
cards.tip: 1st Jupiter good → 2nd Venus good → Hand quality → Long Jupiter finger → Male Fate line

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: SATĪ YOGA DEFINITION & COMPONENTS
cards.front: What five simultaneous palm characteristics constitute the classical Satī Yoga?
cards.back:
Five Features of Satī Yoga:
1. Jupiter Mount well-formed and unblemished.
2. Fingers long, fine, and elegant.
3. Palm soft and supple (resembling a refined female hand).
4. No crooked fingers, especially a perfectly straight Jupiter finger.
5. Venus Mount healthy and well-conditioned (unblemished by moles or grilles).
cards.tip: Good Jupiter + long fine fingers + soft palm + straight Jupiter finger + good Venus

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: MALE FATE LINE & MARITAL SUCCESS
cards.front: Why did the teacher insist that the Fate Line must always be examined in a male hand when reading marriage?
cards.back:
Financial & Domestic Link:
Career foundation is essential for sustained marriage. Many hands possess a pristine Marriage Line and harmonious mounts, yet marriage cannot materialize or dissolves in bitter disputes because the man has no career or steady livelihood.

Without financial stability (Fate Line), marital domestic life collapses under economic pressure.
cards.tip: Without a stable Fate Line in male hand, marriage cannot materialize or survive

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: HAND TYPES IN LOVE VS ARRANGED MARRIAGE
cards.front: Which elemental hand types have the highest statistical probability of a love marriage?
cards.back:
Statistical Propensity:
- Fiery Hand & Watery Hand: Highest probability of love marriage due to emotional intensity, passion, and intuitive romantic drives.
- Earthy & Airy Hands: Lower probability; more inclined toward arranged unions or practical compatibility (though love marriage is not completely excluded).
cards.tip: Fiery & Watery hands = highest love marriage propensity; Earth & Air = practical/arranged

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: HEART LINE TERMINATIONS: SATURN VS JUPITER
cards.front: How do Heart Line endpoints influence the likelihood of love vs arranged marriage?
cards.back:
1. Ends under Saturn Mount:
Practical, self-contained, low emotional romanticism. Minimal inclination for love marriage → predominantly arranged marriage.

2. Ring of Saturn present:
Averse to sentimental romance, extremely rigid/practical; often a "no marriage" sign or strictly formal arranged marriage.

3. Straight to Jupiter Mount:
Balanced idealism with practicality; open to love marriage without losing common sense.

4. Curved to Jupiter ending at palm edge:
Emotionally overwhelmed ("blind in love"), highly prone to romantic love marriage.
cards.tip: Saturn end = arranged/practical; Jupiter end = romantic/love marriage

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: MOON INFLUENCE LINE JOINING FATE LINE
cards.front: What does an influence line from the Moon Mount merging into the Fate Line indicate?
cards.back:
Diagnosis:
Strong indicator of a Love Marriage or an outsider/spouse entering the native's life to elevate fortune and establish a deep emotional matrimonial union at that calculated age.
cards.tip: Influence line from Moon joining Fate line = love marriage / romantic partner

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: CROSS & SVASTIKA ON JUPITER IN LOVE MARRIAGE
cards.front: What role do a Cross and a Svastika on the Jupiter Mount play in love marriages?
cards.back:
1. Cross on Jupiter Mount:
Not an indicator that a love affair will start, but if a romantic relationship exists, it ensures successful conversion into marriage and lifelong marital happiness.

2. Svastika (Satiyā) on Jupiter Mount:
Highly auspicious mark conferring divine marital harmony, mutual respect, and noble familial status.
cards.tip: Cross on Jupiter converts love affair into successful, lasting marriage

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: MARS MOUNTS: LOWER/INNER VS OUTER FOR ROMANCE & REBELLION
cards.front: How do the Lower/Inner Mars and Outer Mars mounts differ when evaluating romance and elopement?
cards.back:
1. Lower / Inner Mars (in female hand):
Governs raw emotional impulses, physical attraction, and romantic inclinations.

2. Outer Mars (Upper Mars percussion side):
Governs defiance, resistance, and rebellion. When examining a rebellious love affair (e.g., elopement, running away from home, defying social taboos), evaluate Outer Mars.
cards.tip: Inner Mars = romantic impulse; Outer Mars = rebellious defiance & elopement

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: REBELLIOUS LOVE MARRIAGE AUXILIARY MARKERS
cards.front: Which auxiliary palm signs indicate an independent, rebellious disposition prone to unconventional romance?
cards.back:
The Rebellious Romance Stack:
1. Sun Finger: Independent, unyielding, refuses to conform to arbitrary social expectations.
2. Thumb: Strong will power (first phalange) enabling bold decisions.
3. Life Line & Mind Line Gap: A wide gap indicates broad-mindedness, unconventional thinking, and self-assertion (ignore if joined by a later line).
4. Star on Inner Mars: Early teenage attraction, living-in arrangements, or unconventional dating.
cards.tip: Independent Sun finger + firm thumb + wide Life-Head gap + Inner Mars star

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: TECHNICAL DEFINITION OF A VENUS GRILLE (JĀLĪ)
cards.front: What is the strict technical definition of a Grille (Jālī) on the Venus Mount according to the teacher?
cards.back:
Strict Definition:
A grille requires AT LEAST 3 vertical and 3 horizontal intersecting lines, and all lines MUST possess the SAME depth and darkness.

If some lines are light and others dark, it is not a genuine grille (since almost every Venus mount has miscellaneous stray lines). A true grille signifies severe anxiety, relationship volatility, and family turmoil.
cards.tip: Grille = at least 3 vertical + 3 horizontal lines of EQUAL darkness; causes anxiety

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: FAMILY RING (KUṬUMB REKHĀ) & THUMB SECOND PHALANGE
cards.front: How do the Family Ring (Kuṭumb Rekhā) and the thumb's second phalange reflect marital harmony?
cards.back:
1. Family Ring (Base of Thumb):
Must exhibit a chain pattern. The chain signifies emotional bonding and domestic warmth. An absence of a chain indicates coldness and emotional disconnection in married life.

2. Second Phalange of Thumb (Logic Phalange):
Excessive chaotic cross-lines indicate ongoing arguments, hyper-criticism, and domestic friction.
cards.tip: Family ring must have chain for emotional bond; excess lines on 2nd phalange = disputes

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: CROOKED JUPITER FINGER & DISCOLORATION
cards.front: Why is a crooked Jupiter finger considered a direct affliction to married life, and what do palm discolorations indicate?
cards.back:
1. Crooked Jupiter Finger:
Indicates a corrupted or afflicted Jupiter energy in both the palm and horoscope, leading directly to distorted values, egotism, and marital turbulence.

2. Discoloration / Dark Spots:
Any localized blackness, grey tint, or yellow discoloration represents an afflicted, diseased, or troubled life sector corresponding to that mount.
cards.tip: Crooked Jupiter finger = direct marital affliction; dark/yellow spots = troubled mount

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: CASE STUDY: 48-YEAR-OLD FEMALE PARTNERSHIP BUSINESS
cards.front: In Dravin ji's female client case (age 48, wanting partnership business), which palm defects were identified, and what was the initial reading?
cards.back:
Identified Palm Signs:
1. Mercury finger slightly low-set and weak (only reaches 2nd phalange of Sun finger → weak commercial instinct).
2. Thumb bent backward excessively → low resolute will power.
3. Life Line dark and lacking smoothness.
4. Oblique line cutting Fate and Life lines at age ~30.

Initial Verdict:
Possibility of commercial business success is low. However, do not outright reject; conduct structured inquiry and calculate future age timelines.
cards.tip: Low-set Mercury finger + bent-back thumb + rough Life line = low business viability

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: FOUR MANDATORY DIAGNOSTIC QUESTIONS FOR BUSINESS CONSULTATION
cards.front: What four mandatory questions must the palmist ask when a client inquires about starting a partnership business?
cards.back:
The 4 Consultation Questions:
1. Industry Nature: Which planet rules the business? (e.g., Jupiter for education/consulting, Mars for food/real estate).
2. Specific Role: What will the client's daily operational role be?
3. Capital Split: What is the investment ratio (50–50 or single investor)?
4. Partner Profile: Is the partner male or female, and are they a family member or third party?
cards.tip: Ask: Business domain (planet), client's role, capital investment split, partner identity

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika — Vivāha Rekhā (Marriage Line), Part 2
cards.tag: FUTURE TIMELINE CALCULATION FOR AGE 48 CLIENT
cards.front: What timeline calculation method did the teacher prescribe for the 48-year-old business consultation client?
cards.back:
Timeline Method:
1. Calculate the exact age 48 position on both the Life Line and the Fate Line.
2. Project 4 to 5 years forward (evaluating ages 48 to 53) on both lines.
3. Scrutinize whether any lines originating from Mars Mount cut across the Life Line or Fate Line during this projected window.
4. If Mars cutting lines exist in this window, advise against partnership capital deployment.
cards.tip: Locate age 48 on Life & Fate lines → project 4–5 years ahead → check for Mars cuts
